title: UAAP: Pasaol mum after late two-pointer in FEU's 3-point loss to Ateneo
summary: Janrey Pasaol was mum about his late floater in Far Eastern University's 75-72 loss to Ateneo de Manila University, the Tamaraws' third straight defeat in UAAP Season 89.
